snippet.title: Blood Bowl 3 | Season 9: Khorne Trailer
snippet.description:
Season 9 will be LIVE in Blood Bowl 3 on June 10th!  The Khorne Faction is coming—brutal, relentless, and hungry for blood! Step onto the pitch and unleash chaos in the latest season.

Blood Bowl 3 is available on PC, PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One.

Find out more at https://www.warhammer-community.com/skulls
